messages:
ani: Heads-up: onboarding sampleapp rerank started throwing mapping errors after yesterday's SDK parity merge.
ben: Error details?
ani: rerank service: `KeyError: 'scores'` when mapping embeddings -> candidates. Node SDK now sends `relevance_scores` field in batch responses.
clare: oh no. python sdk still sends `scores`. So wire name changed but server still expects `scores`.
doc: that shouldn't have happened without an API bump. parity patch must have renamed the field.
ci-bot: :warning: sdk-node@1.13.0 merged parity change: rename(scores -> relevance_scores) in embeddings response.
ben: consequence: rerank mapper fails to align arrays; downstream code assumed exact field name and index parity. Also saw some strange ordering when retries happen.
ani: yes — auth refresh retries re-sent the same batch but node's lazy-encode produced slightly different ordering of candidate ids, so dedupe logic removed one entry and indices shifted.
clare: two issues: field-name mismatch and retry-induced index skew. Short-term fixes: sampleapp adapter that translates `relevance_scores` -> `scores` and asserts lengths before calling rerank. Also add a preflight dim/name check in the console onboarding flow.
doc: long-term: revert the field rename OR ship a server-side compatibility layer that accepts either key. Also add batch idempotency header and canonicalize candidate order before dedupe.
ben: opened PR to add compat shim to server and a small warning in SDK release notes: https://github.com/redwood-inference/service/pull/3213
clare: sampleapp PR to normalize fields and add assert: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sampleapp/pull/220
ci-bot: :white_check_mark: created issue CI-embed-rollback for parity regression tests.
ani: action items: (1) server compat accepting both `scores` and `relevance_scores` (doc), (2) sdk-node revert field rename behind feature flag (ben), (3) sampleapp normalize adapter + onboarding message (clare), (4) add batch-id header + canonical ordering to dedupe (doc).
ben: will also add a small e2e test that simulates retry with different encode order to ensure no index skew.
clare: staging canary in 15m, i'll post metrics.
ani: thanks all 1:30 UTC follow-up in eng-sync if still noisy. :thumbsup:
